## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-*juan* Qing-period selective-extract (節 *jié*) commentary by **Língyào Quánzhāng** 靈耀全彰 on Méngrùn's *Sìjiào yí jízhù* — providing accessible Qing-period extracts of the Yuán combined-edition apparatus. Companion to Língyào's other Tiāntái productions ([KR6d0012](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0012), [KR6d0057](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0057), [KR6d0142](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0142)).

**Abstract**

The composition is bracketed within Língyào's productive period c. 1644–1796 (early-to-mid Qīng era).
